digest.component_or_area: metrics/blame blame attribution and repo cloning guidance
propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns empty list for both git failure and successful-but-empty blame, making failure indistinguishable from legitimate empty result
derive_caused_by can write incorrect caused_by links when git blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, causing strict-majority test to run over incomplete set
Under blobless promisor clone, git blame faults blobs one at a time during every bug close without explicit --caused-by, causing partial path failures
_blame_file_commits must return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty result to enable derive_caused_by to abort on any per-path failure
Repository cloning guidance must document --filter=blob:none (1.04 GiB/59s vs 68.7 MiB/14.3s) and warn that --filter=tree:0 is unacceptable (3.57 GiB)
